theme: Spending your bits where the signal is
title: Spending Your Bits Where the Signal Is
strategies: trivial: fixed reference choice B=6,K=2,G=0, rest of budget on rate -- exactly the checker's own baseline (reproduces B_ref, ~0.1)

greedy: maximize resolution B=16 first (more bits = better SNR intuition), small fixed filter order K=1, no gain G=0, whatever budget is left goes to rate -- never checks whether the resulting rate still gives the antialias cutoff fc=R/2 enough headroom over the target band

strong: recognizes R is fully determined by (B,K) once the shared budget is fixed, collapsing the allocation problem to a small joint search over B in [1,16], K in [0,8], G in [0,12] (144*13 combos), evaluated with exact rational SNR -- exploits where THIS instance's energy actually sits instead of maximizing one axis in isolation

headroom above strong: a continuous relaxation / Lagrangian allocation across (B,K,G) jointly with the spectrum's actual energy distribution, or per-instance adaptive filter-order selection instead of a fixed small integer grid
